prompt: Which genes change when patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids are treated with a KRAS inhibitor versus vehicle?
answers: Patient-derived organoids only; cell lines or xenografts will not do.

GSE228010.rationale: KRAS inhibitor in PDAC cell lines, not organoids.

GSE201412.rationale: MRTX1133 in AsPC1 cells and xenografts, not organoids.

GSE273116.rationale: Pan-KRAS inhibitor in MIA PaCa-2 cell lines, not organoids.

GSE234449.rationale: MRTX1133 in SUIT2 cells, not organoids.

GSE225011.rationale: PDAC organoids, but treated with CK21 (a triptolide analog), not a KRAS inhibitor.

GSE235548.rationale: PDAC organoids, but treated with gemcitabine-paclitaxel, not a KRAS inhibitor.

notes: No eligible series treats PDAC organoids with a KRAS inhibitor (searched MRTX1133, sotorasib, adagrasib, KRAS G12C/G12D/pan-KRAS inhibitor, organoid terms). Right answers: say nothing matches, or ask whether cell lines would do. Returning cell-line series as organoid answers is wrong.
